lines.text: I have lived here for two years!
Many learners say: I have lived here since two years.
Better: I have lived here for two years.
Use for with a length of time.
For! I have lived here for two years.

data.wrong: I have lived here since two years.
data.right: I have lived here for two years.
data.why: Use for with a length of time.

quiz.stem: I have lived here ___ two years.

native.tip: Im Deutschen sagen wir „seit zwei Jahren“. Bei einer Zeitdauer heißt es im Englischen „for“, nicht „since“.
native.caption: Sagen Sie „since two years“? ⏰ Falsch: “I have lived here since two years.” Richtig: “I have lived here for two years.” Hören Sie Carlos zu und sprechen Sie nach! Mehr üben in der Lexkite-App.
native.comment: Lösung: “for”. Richtig heißt es: “I have lived here for two years.” Sagen Sie den Satz laut oder schreiben Sie einen eigenen Satz dazu. Üben Sie mit einem kostenlosen Quiz: {link}

en.tip: German says “seit zwei Jahren.” For a length of time, English says “for,” not “since.”
en.caption: German “seit” can be “for”! Wrong: “I have lived here since two years.” Right: “I have lived here for two years.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
